newsitem.title: USA: Pancho's Q2 same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Pancho's Q2 same-store sales down.

text.p: Pancho's Mexican Buffet Inc said Tuesday that sales in the second quarter were $16.6 million, down from $17.9 million in the 1996 quarter.
The company said same-store sales were down 7.5 percent, compared to a decline of 5.3 percent in the year-ago quarter.

Year-to-date total sales were also down at $33.2 million, compared to $35.4 million in the 1996 period. Year-to-date same-store sales were down 6.1 percent, compared to a decline of 8.9 percent for the first six months of fiscal 1996, the company said.
